text:
tom (PM): Dropping the final GA acceptance checklist here. Need owners for: SLA blurb, monitoring alerts, runbook fallback snippet, pricing footnote. Quick ack + blockers?

rachael (SRE): I'll own SLO doc + alert rules. Two asks: confirm hosted vs dedicated targets and permission to run a staging traffic-steer rehearsal.

omar (Product): Product can accept a looser p99 for 64k context models if we document expected behavior and token-cost tradeoffs. Also need a single-sentence comms line for Sales about Dedicated SLAs.

li (Sales): Safe line for prospects: "Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; pricing & credits negotiated with account teams." Legal wants final wording, but this covers customer questions for now.

maddy (Docs): I'll produce the public GA readiness doc + internal runbook. I need exact promql alerts and the CLI/API example to trigger fallback. ETA: Friday if SRE provides artifacts.

rachael (SRE): Draft SLOs: hosted: availability 99.95%, p99 <= 350ms; dedicated: availability 99.9%, p99 <= 500ms; private: contractual. Policy: when error_budget_burned_pct > 50% sustained for 10m -> auto-traffic-shift to reserve pool + page oncall.

rachael (SRE): Example alert (placeholder):
```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
```
CLI fallback (placeholder):
```bash
redwood traffic shift --policy fallback --from model-large --to model-safe --reason "error_budget_burn"
```
I'll refine before Thu.

tom (PM): Action owners + due dates:
- rachael: finalize SLOs + alert rules + CLI snippets  due Thu EOD (2177856000)
- maddy: publish GA readiness doc + runbook draft  due Fri (2177942400)
- li: draft customer-facing SLA sentence + internal credit calc  due Mon (2178028800)
- omar: decision on premium SLA gating (post-GA vs pilot)  due Mon (2178028800)
- rotations-bot: confirm GA-week rota  due Thu (2177856000)

omar (Product): Product sign-off criteria: docs published (public + internal), SLO doc committed, oncall rota filled for GA week, and provisional pricing page with footnote for Dedicated/private. Premium SLA lane is non-blocking for GA.

li (Sales): ack. We'll use the one-liner until legal finalizes.

maddy (Docs): I'll embed promql and CLI examples verbatim once SRE confirms. Will post to #eng-oncall for review.

rotations-bot: GA-week rota confirmed; primary/secondary assigned.

tom (PM): Please add any unresolved blockers to the acceptance sheet: https://intra.redwood/ga-acceptance. If no objections by Thu EOD we'll mark Ready and schedule the greenlight readout. :white_check_mark:

rachael (SRE): ack.

omar (Product): ack.

li (Sales): ack.

maddy (Docs): ack.
